title: 2-D Correlation
text: 计算两个输入矩阵的二维相关性，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Output size} 指定互相关输出的大小；{Normalized output} 指定归一化互相关输出、{Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 计算得到的互相关 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Output size
params.values: 互相关输出的大小 Full (default) | Same as input port I1 | Valid

params.name: Normalized output
params.values: 归一化互相关输出 off (default) | on

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
